verdict.rationale: Exa is a SaaS search API with SDKs, a hosted MCP server and a dashboard, so opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack has no documentation of telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out controls, data-retention settings or zero-data-retention options. The usage-review and per-key spending limits are billing controls, not privacy opt-outs, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
